name: document-files
description: Analyze document bytes and inspect, convert, render, create, edit, and verify local document artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Headless document reading and file operations
interface.longDescription: Analyze PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HWP, HWPX, HTML, Markdown, and text bytes through a path-independent job contract; inspect local files; convert and render supported formats; and create, edit, and verify HWPX artifacts. Sources remain unchanged, outputs are separate, extraction coverage is explicit, and private work files stay outside the plugin package.
